name: backlink-autofill
description: Project-isolated backlink submission workflow that uses the current Codex/ChatGPT model, browser tools, and reviewed project data without a separate LLM API.

interface.shortDescription: Fill vetted backlink forms with reviewed project data
interface.longDescription: Select one project explicitly, use its reviewed SEO submission data, work through vetted backlink targets in the user's browser, handle normal existing-session login when possible, fill the form, and stop before final submission.
defaultPrompt: Use $backlink-autofill for the selected project and stop before the final submit action
